reason: A DSH host plugin that monitors agent conversation states and alerts users with configurable local audio and Windows notifications, including web controls and links back to conversations.

summaries.zh: 一个在 DSH 对话完成或需要用户关注时播放提示音并显示 Windows 通知的宿主插件，支持网页端配置和通知跳转。
summaries.en: A DSH host plugin that plays configurable sound alerts and shows Windows notifications when conversations finish or require attention, with web-based settings and conversation links.

capabilities: monitors conversation completion and waiting states
provides web-based notification and sound settings
persists and imports or exports local configuration
opens browser links to related conversations
